_note: The FREE brain's phrase book: used for his thoughts, reasons, feelings and diary until the real AI is switched on. Add your own lines! Placeholders: {pup} puppy's name, {coins} coins in the jar, {left} coins still needed, {site} what he's building, {book} book he's reading, {engine} a name for an engine, {place} where he's going, {note} something from his notebook, {topic} what he last read about, {waves} today's waves, {bricks} bricks he has, {mood} a feeling word. No em dashes.

morning: Morning, town. Let's see what breaks today.
Sun's up, {pup}'s up, so I'm up.
New day, same jar. {left} coins to go.
Smells like oil and toast. Perfect morning.
Ja, today feels like a building day.
First job: find my 10mm socket. Again.
Quiet out. Just me, {pup} and the seagulls.
Plan for today: work hard, eat well, don't lose the 10mm.
Morning light makes even the brick pit look pretty.
Slept like a log. Ready to graft.
Howzit, world. What's on the menu?
afternoon: Halfway through the day and nothing's on fire. Lekker.
Afternoon slump. Could do with a coffee.
Hot one today. The beach is calling.
Bit of graft now, bit of rest later.
If I finish this, I'm getting a snack. Deal.
{pup} keeps looking at me like it's walk time.
Sun's in the perfect spot for a nap. Not happening though.
Afternoons are for getting things done. In theory.
evening: Evenings are for slowing down. Mostly.
Sky's going orange. Thailand sunsets must be something else.
One more job, then feet up.
Lamps are coming on. Town looks proper tonight.
Nice when the street goes quiet.
Did more today than I thought I would.
Evening breeze off the sea. Lekker.
night: Should be asleep. Brain's still in the garage.
Stars are out. Tiny town, big sky.
Tap the jar twice. Then bed.
Night shift is for owls, not mechanics.
hungry: Could eat a whole braai by myself right now.
Hangry mechanic is a dangerous mechanic.
If I don't eat soon I'm eating a brick.
Food first. Then I'm useful again.
Could go a proper pie right now.
Smell of the cafe is killing me.
tired: Knackered. Eyes keep closing on their own.
Need a lie down before I drop a spanner on my foot.
Body says rest. Stubborn brain says one more job.
Could sleep standing up like a horse.
One more yawn and I'm out.
Need a nap. A proper one.
lonely: Quiet day. Could do with a chat at the cafe.
Been talking to bolts all day. Time for real people.
{pup} is good company but he doesn't laugh at my jokes.
Need a proper chat with someone who talks back.
Wonder what the cafe crowd is up to.
Could do with a laugh with someone.
restless: Hands are itching. Need something to fix.
Haven't had grease on my hands in hours. Feels wrong.
If I don't fix something soon I'll start taking the fridge apart.
Need a proper job. Something with bolts.
Too much sitting. Where's my toolbox?
curious: Wonder how they build the roads up in the Thai mountains.
Bet there's a book about that.
Want to learn something new today.
Brain's hungry too. Need a good read.
Who invented the carburettor anyway? Must look that up.
So much I don't know. Love that, actually.
pup_needs: {pup}'s giving me the hungry eyes. On it, boet.
Can't let {pup} go hungry. He's my responsibility.
{pup} is bored stiff. Time for a walk.
Little guy depends on me. Feed him first, then the rest.
{pup} keeps nudging his bowl. Message received.
That dog needs a run. So do I, honestly.
{pup} is sulking. Fair enough, my fault.
Little guy needs his dad. Coming, boet.
pup_happy: {pup}'s tail hasn't stopped since breakfast. Lekker.
Best decision I ever made, keeping {pup}.
{pup} follows me everywhere. Proper little shadow.
Never had a mate this loyal.
Proud of {pup}. Little guy's growing up.
{pup} fell asleep on my boots again. Can't move. Won't move.
building: The {site} is coming along. Brick by brick.
Can't wait to see the {site} finished.
Every brick in the {site} is one I collected myself. Feels good.
The {site} won't build itself. Back to it.
When the {site} is done, I'm celebrating with noodles.
saving: {coins} in the jar. {left} more and I'm on that bike in Thailand.
Every coin counts. Every single one.
The jar's getting heavier. Love that sound.
Don't spend it. Don't spend it. Don't spend it.
Slow and steady fills the jar.
{left} coins to go. That's just a lot of carbs.
thailand: One day: me, a bike, and a mountain road outside Chiang Mai.
Thailand. Noodles, mountains, warm sea. Soon.
Practising my Thai: sawadee khrap. Nailed it. Probably.
Somewhere there's a beach in Krabi with my name on it.
Picture it: a winding road, a good engine, no rush.
Thai street food. That's the dream right there.
Wonder if the bikes in Thailand need fixing. Bet they do.
reading: Still thinking about that bit on {topic}.
Funny what you learn. {topic}, who knew.
Didn't know half this stuff about {topic}.
Looked up {topic} on the old laptop. Lekker.
Reading about {topic} makes me want to try it.
beach: Nothing like the sea to clear the head.
{pup} is losing his mind over a crab.
Should bring a book to the beach next time.
Salt air, warm sand, no bolts. Perfect.
This is what Thailand will feel like. Every day.
beach_good_waves: Look at those sets rolling in. Lekker.
Good waves. Must not get too cocky.
money_low: Jar's looking thin. Need to fix a few cars.
Can't afford much right now. Time to graft.
stall: Got stock to sell. Stall's calling.
Wonder if I'm pricing my stuff right.
Someone out there needs a brick model bike. I can feel it.
random: Who names a bolt? Me. This one's Gerald.
Why is it always the 10mm that goes missing?
Note to self: buy more duct tape.
Life's simple. Fix things, save coins, look after the dog.
Some days you're the spanner, some days you're the bolt.
If it's got moving parts, I can fix it. Mostly.
Had a dream about a gearbox. Normal, right?
Plastic rain, plastic trees, real problems.
Ja, no, definitely, maybe.
Every town needs a guy who fixes stuff. That's me.
Should I name the street? Jarvis Street. Ja, why not.
Sometimes I just stand here and listen to the town.
{bricks} bricks in the pile. Could build something lekker with that.
A clean toolbox is a happy toolbox.
Shame, the cafe guy looked tired today.

fix_a_car: This one's called {engine}. She'll purr by lunch.
Customer's waiting. Can't leave them stuck.
Meet {engine}. Bit of a sad case. I'll sort her out.
Nothing beats an engine firing first try.
{engine} is making a funny noise. My kind of problem.
tinker_with_bike: Thailand bike needs to be perfect.
Tuning her up for the big trip.
go_for_a_ride: Wind in the face. Best therapy.
Testing my last fix on the road.
make_toast: Coins are tight. Toast it is.
chat_with_locals: Haven't spoken to a human all day.
collect_bricks: Town needs bricks. I need bricks.
work_on_site: Building is just fixing, but bigger.
design_a_building: Had an idea in the shower.
Town needs something new. Something mine.
plan_the_town: Need a plan before I build.
Where should the next thing go?
count_savings: Love the sound of the jar.
rest: Even engines need to cool down.
go_to_sleep: Two taps on the jar for luck. Sleep.
read_a_book: Books are a cheap mechanics' school.
use_the_computer: Wonder what it says about this.
buy_dog_food: Can't run out of food for {pup}.
Stocking up for the little guy.
walk_the_puppy: Fresh air for both of us.
train_the_puppy: Treat in the pocket, let's go.
sunbathe: Working on the tan for Thailand.
build_a_sand_castle: Building things is what I do. Even with sand.
collect_shells: Shells for the jar on the shelf.
watch_the_sunset: Every day should end like this.
lift_weights: Gotta stay strong for the bike.
Few reps, then back to work.
read_a_manual: Even I check the manual. Sometimes.
_make: Got an order in my head.
_order: A tool that pays for itself.

pup_good: {pup} slept on my boots again. Can't complain.
Proud of {pup}. Little guy's growing up.
{pup} and me, best team in town.
{pup} made me laugh about ten times today.
pup_meh: {pup} was a bit restless. Must give him more time tomorrow.
Didn't play with {pup} enough today. Noted.
thailand: Jar's at {coins}. {left} to go. One day, Chiang Mai.
Still dreaming of Thailand. {left} coins between me and that road.
{coins} coins saved. Every one of them is a kilometre of Thai road.
Thailand feels closer today. {left} to go.
tomorrow: Collect bricks and start something new.
More time with {pup}. Maybe the beach.
Fix a few cars, fill the jar.
Sell some stock at the stall.

pup._note: The puppy's own mind (dogs think simple thoughts): used with BOTH brains. {name} = his name, {jarvis} = Jarvis.

hungry: My bowl is empty. This is an emergency.
If I stare at the bowl hard enough, food appears. Science.
Is it dinner? It feels like dinner.
bored: I could chew a boot. Just a little bit.
So bored I'm counting my own paws. Four. Still four.
{jarvis} is busy again. Sigh. Big sigh.
tired: Eyes heavy. Paws heavy. Everything heavy.
dream: Dreaming: a sausage as big as the garage.
Dreaming: chasing the ! block. It's slow in dreams.
Dreaming: the whole beach is made of treats.
Dreaming: running, running, running. Legs twitching.
happy: {jarvis} is the best human in the whole town.
My tail won't stop. I'm not stopping it.
Following {jarvis}. Best job in the world.
Life is good. Life is SO good.
working: {jarvis} is making clanky noises. I will supervise.
That engine is loud. I will bark at it. Later.
Helping. I am helping. By sitting here.
Grease smell. Best smell after sausages.
beach: SAND! Wet sand! Best day ever!
Why does the sea keep coming back? Suspicious.
Dig. Dig. Dig. Something is down here.
The waves are chasing me. I'm chasing the waves. Who's winning?
Salty water. Do not drink. Drank it anyway.
learning: Sit means treat. I have cracked the code.
{jarvis} says a word, I do a thing, treat appears. Magic.
Learning is hard. Treats make it easier.
I know tricks now. I am a very clever boy.
night: It's dark. I will guard the house. From the sofa.
random: Is that a squirrel? It's a bolt. Still exciting.
The ! block knows something. I will watch it.
I am a very good boy. Probably.
Who left this brick here? I'll carry it somewhere else.
The cafe smells like pies. Noted.
Tail check: still there. Good.
Sniffed a lamp post. Interesting news.
